Title: 502673-2026: Italy – Construction of aircraft maintenance halls – Venaria Reale (TO) - M. Santi Airport (ID 810) - Construction of a new hangar, aprons and service building
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of aircraft hangars are long-span structures and belong to sbp’s preferred project types. The location in Italy reduces the priority compared to DACH projects.
titel: Venaria Reale M. Santi Airport – New construction of a hangar, aprons and service building
kurzbeschreibung: New construction of an aircraft hangar with aprons and a service building at Venaria Reale Airport.
umfang: Construction works for a new aircraft maintenance hangar including paved apron areas or parking stands and a service building at M. Santi Airport; estimated contract value 30.538.331,95 EUR net; further technical parameters such as spans, areas or GFA are not stated in the notice.
leistungen: Construction works for the realization of a new hangar, apron or stand areas and a service building; restricted procedure.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Basically relevant as a long-span special structure, since hangars often require large column-free spans.
• Potentially interesting for sbp due to possible structural complexity and lightweight design potential.
• However, it is primarily a construction tender without an explicitly stated share of design or structural engineering services.
• Technical information on the structure, spans or construction type is missing, so the actual complexity cannot be substantiated.
• Large project volume and international market indicate a certain strategic relevance.
• Military contracting authority and defence context may practically restrict access and suitability for sbp.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee for design services stated. This is a construction tender; a separate fee for sbp cannot be derived from the notice.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria according to the tender documents; not specified in detail in the notice itself.
zuschlagskriterien: Quality; MEAT. Exact weighting is not stated in the notice.
auftraggeber: COMANDO INFRASTRUTTURE, Viale dell Esercito 123, 00100 Rome, Italy, E-mail: comgenio@postacert.difesa.it, Tel.: +390650236038
notes: Contract amendment notice; previous notice was cancelled due to an error in the electronic procedure. Estimated duration is stated as 24 days, while 31.12.2029 is given as a performance condition; this appears contradictory. Option stated as 6/5 contrattuale - quinto d obbligo. Language of the procedure: Italian.
